title: Adversarial Certificate Testing
mathematical_claim: Finite partition refinement terminates after at most |S|-1 strict refinement rounds; a quotient preserves observations, required properties, enabled actions, and successor blocks.
profound_finding: A certificate is only as unambiguous as its identity encoding; when identity is ambiguous, fail closed rather than silently accepting a quotient.
limitations: Tests require execution in repository CI to claim a pass
repr collision rejection is a guard, not a canonical serialization standard
next_rung: CXLXIV — Canonical Typed Encoding and Differential Fuzzing
